description: Delete one search saved with pitchspark_save_search_v1 under the caller's API key, by its saved_search_id (the "id" from pitchspark_save_search_v1 or pitchspark_list_saved_searches_v1). Use when: the investor asks to delete, remove or forget a saved search. Do not use for: finding startups (pitchspark_search_pitches_v3), listing saved searches (pitchspark_list_saved_searches_v1), removing saved pitches (pitchspark_unwatch_pitch_v1). Only a search saved under the same API key can be deleted; the deletion cannot be undone, but the search can be saved again. An id that is not found changes nothing (status "not_found"). Requires a PitchSpark API key with the searches:write scope (keys without a scope list hold it). Uses none of the daily pitch allowance. Returns {"status" (deleted or not_found), "saved_search_id", "next_steps"}.

saved_search_id.description: The "id" of a saved search, copied exactly from pitchspark_save_search_v1 or pitchspark_list_saved_searches_v1.

name: pitchspark_delete_saved_search_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

title: Delete a saved startup search
